# NEW 2026-11-20 v6.7 batch 9 A: the themes' own yearly replenishment (oe_tq_). Generated by gen_theme_quota.py;
# edit the generator, not this file.

# Theme country scope unless noted. No debug output in this file (test readout: oe_tq_quota_test.txt).

# Location scope (the seat). One galley of the current age for $owner$; types as the first maker's
# oe_theme_create_ten_current_age_galleys (oe_theme_expansion.txt), one at a time.
oe_tq_one_galley = {
    if = { limit = { current_age = age_1_traditions } create_sub_unit_with_owner = { type = n_traditional_galley owner = $owner$ } }
    else_if = { limit = { current_age = age_2_renaissance } create_sub_unit_with_owner = { type = n_mediterrannean_galley owner = $owner$ } }
    else_if = { limit = { current_age = age_3_discovery } create_sub_unit_with_owner = { type = n_war_galley owner = $owner$ } }
    else_if = { limit = { current_age = age_4_reformation } create_sub_unit_with_owner = { type = n_galleass owner = $owner$ } }
    else_if = { limit = { current_age = age_5_absolutism } create_sub_unit_with_owner = { type = n_xebec owner = $owner$ } }
    else_if = { limit = { current_age = age_6_revolutions } create_sub_unit_with_owner = { type = n_archipelago_frigate owner = $owner$ } }
}

# BYZ's yearly sum: cleared at the first use in a new year.
oe_tq_sum_open = {
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:BYZ c:BYZ = { OR = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_tq_sum_year } var:oe_tq_sum_year < current_year } } }
        c:BYZ = {
            set_variable = { name = oe_tq_sum_year value = current_year }
            set_variable = { name = oe_tq_sum_regs value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = oe_tq_sum_ships value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = oe_tq_sum_gold value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = oe_tq_sum_byz value = 0 }
        }
    }
}

# One land step: the first maker's two regiments at the seat, paid by the theme (and the empire's share).
oe_tq_land_step = {
    save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = oe_tq_g_t value = oe_tq_land_gold_theme }
    save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = oe_tq_g_b value = oe_tq_land_gold_byz }
    save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = oe_tq_n0 value = num_regiments }
    capital = { oe_theme_create_two_current_age_infantry = { owner = scope:oe_tq_theme } }
    save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = oe_tq_made value = oe_tq_made_land }
    add_gold = { value = scope:oe_tq_g_t multiply = -1 }
    add_manpower = -1.2
    if = { limit = { scope:oe_tq_g_b > 0 country_exists = c:BYZ } c:BYZ = { add_gold = { value = scope:oe_tq_g_b multiply = -1 } } }
    set_variable = { name = oe_tq_last value = 1 }
    if = { limit = { scope:oe_tq_made >= 2 } set_variable = { name = oe_tq_chk value = 1 } }
    else_if = { limit = { scope:oe_tq_made >= 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_tq_chk value = 2 } }
    else = { set_variable = { name = oe_tq_chk value = 3 } }
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:BYZ }
        c:BYZ = {
            change_variable = { name = oe_tq_sum_regs add = scope:oe_tq_made }
            change_variable = { name = oe_tq_sum_gold add = scope:oe_tq_g_t }
            change_variable = { name = oe_tq_sum_byz add = scope:oe_tq_g_b }
        }
    }
}

# One navy step: one galley at the seat.
oe_tq_sea_step = {
    save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = oe_tq_g_t value = oe_tq_sea_gold_theme }
    save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = oe_tq_g_b value = oe_tq_sea_gold_byz }
    save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = oe_tq_n0 value = regular_navy_size }
    capital = { oe_tq_one_galley = { owner = scope:oe_tq_theme } }
    save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = oe_tq_made value = oe_tq_made_sea }
    add_gold = { value = scope:oe_tq_g_t multiply = -1 }
    if = { limit = { scope:oe_tq_g_b > 0 country_exists = c:BYZ } c:BYZ = { add_gold = { value = scope:oe_tq_g_b multiply = -1 } } }
    set_variable = { name = oe_tq_last value = 1 }
    if = { limit = { scope:oe_tq_made >= 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_tq_chk value = 1 } }
    else = { set_variable = { name = oe_tq_chk value = 4 } }
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:BYZ }
        c:BYZ = {
            change_variable = { name = oe_tq_sum_ships add = scope:oe_tq_made }
            change_variable = { name = oe_tq_sum_gold add = scope:oe_tq_g_t }
            change_variable = { name = oe_tq_sum_byz add = scope:oe_tq_g_b }
        }
    }
}

# The yearly check of one theme (the test buttons call it directly, without the year guard).
oe_tq_run = {
    save_scope_as = oe_tq_theme
    oe_tq_sum_open = yes
    set_variable = { name = oe_tq_chk value = 0 }
    if = { limit = { oe_tq_eligible = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_tq_quota value = oe_tq_quota_value } }
    else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_tq_quota } remove_variable = oe_tq_quota }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_tq_off } set_variable = { name = oe_tq_last value = 10 } }
    else_if = { limit = { NOT = { oe_tq_eligible = yes } } set_variable = { name = oe_tq_last value = 9 } }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_tfr_target_display > 0 } set_variable = { name = oe_tq_last value = 8 } }
    else_if = { limit = { NOT = { oe_tq_loyal = yes } } set_variable = { name = oe_tq_last value = 5 } }
    else_if = { limit = { NOT = { oe_tq_seat_ok = yes } } set_variable = { name = oe_tq_last value = 6 } }
    else_if = {
        limit = { oe_tq_land = yes }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { oe_tq_land_room_ok = yes } } set_variable = { name = oe_tq_last value = 2 } }
        else_if = { limit = { NOT = { gold >= oe_tq_land_need } } set_variable = { name = oe_tq_last value = 3 } }
        else_if = { limit = { NOT = { manpower >= 1.2 } } set_variable = { name = oe_tq_last value = 4 } }
        else = {
            oe_tq_land_step = yes
            if = {
                limit = { oe_tq_steps >= 2 var:oe_tq_chk ?= 1 oe_tq_land_room_ok = yes gold >= oe_tq_land_need manpower >= 1.2 oe_tq_seat_ok = yes }
                oe_tq_land_step = yes
            }
        }
    }
    else = {
        if = { limit = { NOT = { oe_tq_sea_room_ok = yes } } set_variable = { name = oe_tq_last value = 2 } }
        else_if = { limit = { NOT = { gold >= oe_tq_sea_need } } set_variable = { name = oe_tq_last value = 3 } }
        else = {
            oe_tq_sea_step = yes
            if = {
                limit = { oe_tq_steps >= 2 var:oe_tq_chk ?= 1 oe_tq_sea_room_ok = yes gold >= oe_tq_sea_need oe_tq_seat_ok = yes }
                oe_tq_sea_step = yes
            }
        }
    }
}

# The dispatcher's sixth step (January): once a year per theme.
oe_tq_yearly = {
    if = {
        limit = { OR = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_tq_year } var:oe_tq_year < current_year } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_tq_year value = current_year }
        oe_tq_run = yes
    }
}
